2608.03025.title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusio
2608.03025.paper_summary: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting. We directly supervise per-type diffusion scores as classification logits, learn aggregation across noise levels, and use antithetic sampling to reduce Monte Carlo comparison variance. Our analysis shows that classifier-free guidance sharpens the induced type posterior and characterises when antithetic pairing reduces variance at equal denoiser cost. Experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 show consistent gains over a matched deterministic ImaginE control under the same encoder, auxiliary objectives, and evaluation protocol, supported by ablations and paired significance tests.
2608.03025.paper_summary_zh: 多模態命名實體識別 (MNER) 確定每個候選範圍和實體類型假設是否得到聯合文本和視覺證據的支持。現有的想像與比較驗證器將每個 (範圍, 類型) 配對映射到一個預測的視覺特徵，將多樣的視覺實現壓縮成單一原型，並提供兼容性分數而不需明確的概率語義。我們引入了 DiffImaginE，將 MNER 類型驗證公式化為條件潛在擴散推理。在給定範圍局部化的視覺證據下，類型條件去噪器預測注入其標準化潛在的噪聲。由此產生的去噪誤差提供了一個與 ELBO 一致的替代品，用於類型條件的負對數似然，允許根據它們解釋觀察的能力對競爭的類型假設進行排名。DiffImaginE 保留了標準的多模態編碼器堆疊，並用使用 Min-SNR 加權訓練的無分類器引導擴散評分器替換了確定性驗證器。我們直接監督每類型的擴散分數作為分類邏輯，學習跨噪聲水平的聚合，並使用對立抽樣來減少蒙特卡洛比較的方差。我們的分析顯示，無分類器引導能夠提高誘導的類型後驗，並表徵在相同去噪器成本下對立配對何時減少方差。在 Twitter-2015 和 Twitter-2017 上的實驗顯示，在相同的編碼器、輔助目標和評估協議下，相較於匹配的確定性 ImaginE 控制，始終有穩定的增益，這得到了消融實驗和配對顯著性測試的支持。
